add-text-to-pdf-page-at-specific-coordin.title: Add Text to PDF Page at Specific Coordinates
add-text-to-pdf-page-at-specific-coordin.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a TextFragment, set its X/Y position, add it to the first page, and save the modified document.

insert-identical-text-on-all-pdf-pages.title: Insert Identical Text on All PDF Pages
insert-identical-text-on-all-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to add the same plain text to every page of a PDF by iterating through the document's Pages collection and inserting a TextFragment into each page's Paragraphs collection.

load-custom-ttf-font-and-apply-to-text.title: Load Custom TrueType Font from Memory Stream
load-custom-ttf-font-and-apply-to-text.description: Shows how to read a TrueType font into a memory stream, register it with FontRepository, and apply it to a TextFragment's TextState for PDF creation.

apply-opentype-font-to-textfragment.title: Apply Custom OTF Font to TextFragment
apply-opentype-font-to-textfragment.description: Shows how to load an OpenType (OTF) font, register it with Aspose.Pdf, and apply it to a TextFragment for styled PDF text.

set-character-spacing-pdf.title: Set Character Spacing for Text in a PDF
set-character-spacing-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to adjust the inter‑character gap by setting the CharacterSpacing property on a TextState before adding a TextFragment to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

left-align-text-pdf.title: Add Left-Aligned Text to PDF Page
left-align-text-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a TextFragment, set its HorizontalAlignment to Left, add it to a page, and save the modified document.

center-text-horizontally-in-pdf.title: Center Text Horizontally in a PDF
center-text-horizontally-in-pdf.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, create a TextFragment, set its HorizontalAlignment to Center, and save the document with the text centered on the page.

right-align-text-in-pdf.title: Right‑Align Text on a PDF Page
right-align-text-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create a TextFragment, set its HorizontalAlignment to Right, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multi-line-text-paragraph.title: Create Multi‑Line Text Paragraph in PDF
add-multi-line-text-paragraph.description: Demonstrates how to build a multi‑line paragraph using TextFragment, configure its formatting and margins, and add it to a PDF page with Aspose.Pdf.

insert-hyperlink-into-pdf-text-segment.title: Add Clickable Hyperlink to PDF
insert-hyperlink-into-pdf-text-segment.description: Shows how to insert a clickable hyperlink into a PDF by creating a styled TextSegment and attaching a LinkAnnotation with a URI action.

add-styled-html-fragment-to-pdf-page.title: Add Styled HTML Fragment to PDF
add-styled-html-fragment-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, create an HtmlFragment with CSS styling, optionally set a TextState, and insert it into a page.

add-footnote-with-image-to-pdf.title: Insert Image into PDF Footnote
add-footnote-with-image-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a footnote on a PDF page, add descriptive text, and embed an image within the footnote using Aspose.Pdf.

add-table-to-pdf-footnote.title: Add a Table to a Footnote Using Tagged PDF Content
add-table-to-pdf-footnote.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's TaggedContent API to create a footnote-like DivElement, add a paragraph, and embed a table within the footnote of an existing PDF.

add-endnote-bold-italic.title: Insert Endnote with Bold and Italic Formatting
add-endnote-bold-italic.description: Shows how to add an endnote to the last page of a PDF and apply bold and italic styles using a TextFragment and its TextState settings.

inline-text-image-paragraph.title: Add Inline Image to Text in PDF
inline-text-image-paragraph.description: Shows how to combine a TextFragment and an Image fragment within a single paragraph to create an inline text‑image element in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-invisible-tooltip-button-over-text.title: Add Invisible Tooltip Buttons Over Text in PDF
add-invisible-tooltip-button-over-text.description: Demonstrates how to locate specific text in a PDF, overlay an invisible ButtonField on each occurrence, and attach a JavaScript mouse‑enter action to show a tooltip.

find-phrase-occurrences-with-textabsorbe.title: Find All Occurrences of a Phrase in a PDF using TextAbsorber
find-phrase-occurrences-with-textabsorbe.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, extract raw text from each page with TextAbsorber, and locate every case‑insensitive occurrence of a specific phrase.

replace-phrase-preserve-formatting.title: Replace Text Phrases in PDF While Preserving Formatting
replace-phrase-preserve-formatting.description: Demonstrates how to locate specific text fragments in a PDF and replace them with new text while keeping the original formatting using Aspose.Pdf.

add-header-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Header to All PDF Pages
add-header-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to iterate through a PDF document's pages and add a header text fragment to each page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-footer-page-numbers-to-pdf.title: Insert Page Number Footer into PDF
add-footer-page-numbers-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load an existing PDF, iterate through its pages, and add a footer with page numbers using a TextFragment placeholder, then save the modified document.

rotate-added-text-in-pdf.title: Rotate Text in PDF with Aspose.Pdf
rotate-added-text-in-pdf.description: Shows how to add a text fragment to a PDF page and rotate it by setting the TextState.Rotation (or TextMatrix) before saving the document.

apply-background-color-to-text.title: Apply Background Color to Text in PDF
apply-background-color-to-text.description: Demonstrates how to set a background color for a text fragment by configuring the TextState.BackgroundColor property before adding it to a PDF page.

set-font-size-color-textfragment.title: Set Font Size and Color for a TextFragment
set-font-size-color-textfragment.description: Demonstrates how to define font size and foreground color using the TextState of a TextFragment and add it to a PDF page.

add-text-to-pdf-from-memory-stream.title: Add Text to PDF Using Memory Streams
add-text-to-pdf-from-memory-stream.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a MemoryStream, inserting a text fragment at a specific position, and saving the modified document back to a stream.

convert-modified-pdf-to-byte-array.title: Save Modified PDF to Byte Array
convert-modified-pdf-to-byte-array.description: Loads a PDF, adds a text annotation to the first page, and saves the modified document into a byte array using a MemoryStream for further processing or transmission.

add-text-and-encrypt-pdf.title: Add Text and Encrypt PDF with Password
add-text-and-encrypt-pdf.description: The example loads a PDF, adds a "Confidential" text fragment to the first page, then encrypts the document with a user and owner password using AES‑256 and specific permissions before saving it.

add-underlined-text-to-pdf.title: Add Underlined Text to PDF
add-underlined-text-to-pdf.description: Loads an existing PDF, creates a TextFragment, enables underline via TextState, positions the fragment, and saves the modified document.

create-strikethrough-text-pdf.title: Create Strikethrough Text in PDF
create-strikethrough-text-pdf.description: Shows how to enable the StrikeOut property of a TextFragment's TextState to render strikethrough text and save the result as a PDF document.

render-superscript-text.title: Create Superscript Text in a PDF
render-superscript-text.description: Demonstrates how to add normal and superscript text to a PDF by using TextFragment objects, setting font properties, and positioning the superscript higher than the baseline.

render-subscript-text.title: Render Subscript Text in PDF with Aspose.Pdf
render-subscript-text.description: Shows how to add subscript text to an existing PDF by creating a TextFragment, setting its font and position (lowering the Y‑coordinate), and inserting it into a page.

set-custom-line-spacing-pdf.title: Set Line Spacing for Added Text in PDF
set-custom-line-spacing-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, add a multi‑line TextFragment, adjust its line spacing (leading) via the TextState, and save the updated document.

adjust-word-spacing-in-pdf.title: Adjust Word Spacing When Adding Text to PDF
adjust-word-spacing-in-pdf.description: Shows how to configure the TextState.WordSpacing property of a TextFragment before placing it on a PDF page, using Aspose.Pdf.

justify-text-in-pdf.title: Justify Text in PDF Using TextFragment
justify-text-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create a TextFragment, set its horizontal alignment to Justify, and save the modified document.

add-arabic-bidi-text-to-pdf.title: Generate PDF with Mixed LTR and RTL Text
add-arabic-bidi-text-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to render left‑to‑right and right‑to‑left Unicode characters in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by setting the TextState and using a Unicode‑capable font.

set-custom-line-height-pdf-text.title: Set Custom Line Spacing for Text in a PDF
set-custom-line-height-pdf-text.description: Shows how to assign a custom line height (line spacing) to a TextFragment using Aspose.Pdf's TextState and save the modified PDF.

emulate-kerning-in-pdf-text.title: Simulate Kerning in PDF TextFragment
emulate-kerning-in-pdf-text.description: Loads an existing PDF, adds a TextFragment with character spacing to simulate kerning, and saves the modified document.

render-text-with-ligatures.title: Add Text to PDF and Discuss Ligature Support
render-text-with-ligatures.description: Shows how to add a text fragment to a PDF, set its font and size, and explains that ligature activation is handled internally by Aspose.Pdf and cannot be toggled via the API.

enable-hyphenation-long-words-pdf.title: Enable Hyphenation When Adding Text to PDF
enable-hyphenation-long-words-pdf.description: The example loads a PDF, extracts its text, then adds a new TextFragment with hyphenation enabled (using reflection for compatibility) and saves the modified document.

embed-css-in-htmlfragment.title: Embed CSS in HTML Fragment for PDF Styling
embed-css-in-htmlfragment.description: Demonstrates how to embed CSS rules inside an HtmlFragment and add it to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf, then save the styled PDF.

create-text-link-goto-action.title: Create Internal Link to Page Using GoToAction
create-text-link-goto-action.description: Shows how to add a clickable text fragment that navigates to another page within the same PDF by using a LinkAnnotation with a GoToAction.

add-clickable-hyperlink-text-to-pdf.title: Add Clickable Text Link to PDF
add-clickable-hyperlink-text-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a TextFragment onto a PDF page and attach a URI link annotation so the text becomes a clickable hyperlink that opens a web address.

create-pdf-launch-action-open-external-f.title: Add Clickable Text to Open an External File
create-pdf-launch-action-open-external-f.description: Demonstrates how to place a text fragment in a PDF and attach a LaunchAction via a LinkAnnotation so that clicking the text opens an external file.

rotate-specific-text-fragment.title: Rotate Specific Text Fragment in PDF
rotate-specific-text-fragment.description: Loads a PDF, searches for a given text string, rotates the first found text fragment by 45 degrees, and saves the modified document.

insert-rotated-text-second-page.title: Insert Rotated Text on Second PDF Page
insert-rotated-text-second-page.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's TextBuilder to add a rotated TextFragment to the second page of an existing PDF document.

create-rotated-text-paragraph.title: Rotate a Text Paragraph in PDF
create-rotated-text-paragraph.description: Demonstrates creating a paragraph from multiple TextFragment objects and applying a 30‑degree rotation to the entire line by setting the rotation on each fragment's TextState.

replace-confidential-with-public-in-pdf.title: Replace 'Confidential' with 'Public' in PDF
replace-confidential-with-public-in-pdf.description: Shows how to locate a specific phrase in a PDF and replace it with another string using Aspose.Pdf's TextFragmentAbsorber and TextSearchOptions.

extract-email-addresses-from-pdf.title: Extract Email Addresses from PDF Pages
extract-email-addresses-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract the text of each page using TextAbsorber, apply a regular expression to locate email addresses, and collect the results per page.

detect-manual-line-breaks-in-textfragmen.title: Identify Line Break Flags in a Multi‑Line TextFragment
detect-manual-line-breaks-in-textfragmen.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through the lines of a TextFragment, detect the original line‑break characters using regex, and use the resulting flags for custom layout before adding the fragment to a PDF document.

append-disclaimer-to-first-pdf-page.title: Append Disclaimer Text to First PDF Page
append-disclaimer-to-first-pdf-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create a TextFragment containing a disclaimer, and add it to the first page's paragraph collection before saving.

rotate-header-text-pdf.title: Rotate Header Text in PDFs by 90 Degrees
rotate-header-text-pdf.description: Iterates through PDF files in a folder, detects header text fragments based on font size, and rotates those fragments 90 degrees using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-text-rotate-page-save-memory-str.title: Replace Text and Rotate PDF Page, Save to MemoryStream
replace-text-rotate-page-save-memory-str.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, replacing specific text, rotating the first page, and saving the modified document into a MemoryStream using Aspose.Pdf.

search-text-pdf-with-logging.title: Search Text in PDF and Log Results
search-text-pdf-with-logging.description: The example opens a PDF, searches for a specified term using TextFragmentAbsorber, records the number of occurrences, writes a simple log file, and then displays the log content.

extract-line-break-positions-from-pdf.title: Extract Line Break Positions from PDF Text
extract-line-break-positions-from-pdf.description: Shows how to extract text fragments from a PDF, group them by Y coordinate to identify lines, and write each line's Y position and start/end X coordinates to a JSON file.

add-rotated-text-watermark-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Rotated Text Watermark to PDF Pages
add-rotated-text-watermark-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's TextBuilder and TextFragment to place a rotated "CONFIDENTIAL" watermark on every page of a PDF document.

replace-text-on-specific-pdf-pages.title: Replace Text on Specific PDF Pages
replace-text-on-specific-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to replace a given string only within a defined page range of a PDF by iterating pages and using TextFragmentAbsorber.

highlight-keyword-occurrences-pdf.title: Case‑Insensitive Keyword Highlighting in PDF
highlight-keyword-occurrences-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to search for a keyword in a PDF without regard to case and highlight each occurrence using Aspose.Pdf's TextFragment and color settings.

insert-rotated-mixed-style-text-paragrap.title: Insert Rotated Mixed-Style Text on PDF Page
insert-rotated-mixed-style-text-paragrap.description: Loads an existing PDF, ensures it has at least three pages, creates a TextFragment with two differently styled TextSegments, rotates the fragment 45 degrees, and adds it to the third page.

batch-replace-multiple-strings-in-pdf.title: Batch Replace Multiple Strings in PDFs
batch-replace-multiple-strings-in-pdf.description: Shows how to iterate through PDF files in a folder and replace several specified strings with new values using Aspose.Pdf's text absorption and replacement features.

extract-page-word-count-to-csv.title: Extract PDF Page Word Counts to CSV
extract-page-word-count-to-csv.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf to extract text from each page of a PDF, count the words, and output per‑page word counts into a CSV file.

rotate-draft-text-fragments.title: Rotate 'Draft' Text Fragments in PDF
rotate-draft-text-fragments.description: Shows how to locate all text containing the word "Draft" using TextFragmentAbsorber and rotate those text fragments by 15 degrees in a PDF document.

find-dates-in-pdf-using-regex.title: Find Dates in PDF Using TextFragmentAbsorber
find-dates-in-pdf-using-regex.description: Shows how to locate all dates in the MM/DD/YYYY format within a PDF by applying a regular‑expression TextFragmentAbsorber.

rotate-table-cell-text.title: Rotate Text in Table Cell
rotate-table-cell-text.description: Demonstrates how to rotate text inside a PDF table cell by 60 degrees using TextFragment's TextState.Rotation and save the updated layout.

rotate-pdf-title-text-45-degrees.title: Rotate PDF Title Text by 45 Degrees
rotate-pdf-title-text-45-degrees.description: Shows how to identify large‑font text fragments (treated as titles) in a PDF and rotate them 45° using Aspose.Pdf before saving the modified files.

add-rotated-text-bottom-right-last-page.title: Add Rotated Text to Bottom‑Right of Last PDF Page
add-rotated-text-bottom-right-last-page.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's TextFragment to place rotated text at the bottom‑right corner of the last page of a PDF document.

replace-text-with-clickable-hyperlink.title: Search and Replace Text with Clickable Hyperlink in PDF
replace-text-with-clickable-hyperlink.description: Demonstrates how to locate a specific phrase in a PDF, replace it with styled hyperlink text, and add a clickable LinkAnnotation that opens a URL.

extract-pdf-text-sentences-per-page.title: Extract PDF Text and Save Each Sentence on a Separate Page
extract-pdf-text-sentences-per-page.description: Demonstrates how to extract all text from a PDF, split it into individual sentences, and write each sentence to its own page in a new PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-replace-keywords-in-pdf.title: Batch Replace Text in PDF Using Aspose.Pdf and JSON Config
batch-replace-keywords-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to read a JSON mapping of old and new strings and replace all occurrences of each keyword across all pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-text-in-pdf-using-fuzzy-regex.title: Find Approximate Text in PDF with Fuzzy Matching
replace-text-in-pdf-using-fuzzy-regex.description: Demonstrates how to locate approximate occurrences of a target phrase in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's fuzzy search option, with version‑agnostic reflection to enable the feature.

show-popup-on-button-mouse-enter.title: Show Popup Annotation on Button Hover with HideAction
show-popup-on-button-mouse-enter.description: Demonstrates how to display a PopupAnnotation when the mouse enters a button field by assigning a HideAction with the show flag set to false.

add-arabic-rtl-text-to-pdf.title: Add Right-to-Left Arabic Text to PDF
add-arabic-rtl-text-to-pdf.description: Loads an existing PDF, inserts an Arabic text fragment with right‑to‑left direction using a Unicode font, and saves the modified document.

add-text-annotation-to-pdf-page.title: Create a Text Annotation in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf
add-text-annotation-to-pdf-page.description: The example loads a PDF, creates a TextAnnotation with title, contents and icon, adds it to the first page, and saves the document. It also notes the current limitation of attaching JavaScript actions to text annotations.

add-semi-transparent-text-to-pdf.title: Add Semi‑Transparent Text to a PDF
add-semi-transparent-text-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to set text opacity by configuring the TextState's foreground color with an alpha value and adding the TextFragment to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

append-multiline-textfragment-line-break.title: Append Multi-line TextFragment and Retrieve Line Break Information
append-multiline-textfragment-line-break.description: Demonstrates adding a multi-line TextFragment to a PDF page with Aspose.Pdf and inspecting its TextSegment collection to determine where line breaks occur for custom rendering.

add-semi-transparent-text-watermark__v2.title: Add Semi-Transparent Text Watermark to PDF
add-semi-transparent-text-watermark__v2.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a semi‑transparent text watermark on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TextStamp and TextState.

extract-text-from-pdf-to-utf8-file__v2.title: Extract Text from PDF to UTF-8 File
extract-text-from-pdf-to-utf8-file__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract all plain text using TextAbsorber, and write the concatenated result to a UTF-8 encoded text file.

rotate-text-box-form-field.title: Rotate Text in a PDF Form Field via Appearance Stream
rotate-text-box-form-field.description: Demonstrates how to rotate the visual representation of a PDF text form field by modifying its normal appearance XForm matrix and saving the updated document.
